name: feedback-plumbing
body:
Feedback plumbing must be correct end to end. Two contracts: (A) Feedback→Note reviews round-trip. After `apg review add --project

`, a fresh `apg_query` (and `apg review list`) returns the Feedback attached to the Note, i.e. the `Feedback-[:Reviews]->Note` edge is queryable in `db.lbug` with no scan. `Note`→`Note` `Details` stays refused. (B) The pre-merge verify gate spans every feedback scope. While any Feedback in the project's transient stores — the plan store plus the five tier mirrors — is `open`/`actioned`, `apg plan verify ` refuses and names that feedback FQN; once all are `resolved`, it passes (absent other blockers). `apg plan complete` remains phase-scoped (it gates only the phase and its tasks). Contains the child requirements `feedback-note-reviews-round-trip` (A) and `verify-gate-all-feedback-scopes` (B). `review-surface-unchanged` continues to hold: no `apg review` subcommand changes.
